product_brief: Secure file transfer application supporting SFTP, SCP, WebDAV, and S3 protocols with post-quantum ML-KEM support.
pqc_capability_description: WinSCP 6.4.2 beta (released 2025-01-27) introduced support for the Post-quantum ML-KEM key encapsulation method. No further details on hybrid modes or specific PQC signature schemes are provided in the text.
crypto_primitives: ECDSA (specifically ecdsa-sha2-nistp521 mentioned in vulnerability context), RSA (rsa-sha2-256, rsa-sha2-512), HMAC-SHA-512, AES (Hardware-accelerated), ML-KEM
key_management_model: Support for OpenSSH ssh-agent, OpenSSH certificates, and PuTTY PPK version 3 keys.
primary_platforms: Windows (implied by "Windows 11 flat style graphics", "MSI installer", "Embarcadero C++Builder")
pqc_roadmap_details: ML-KEM key encapsulation method added in version 6.4.2 beta.
implementation_attack_surface: Critical vulnerability CVE-2024-31497 in the use of 521-bit ECDSA keys (ecdsa-sha2-nistp521) fixed in version 6.3.3. Mitigation for “Terrapin” vulnerability via PuTTY 0.80 upgrade in version 6.2.2. Security fix for URL handling in version 5.18.1 and 5.17.10.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Dependencies include OpenSSL (versions 1.1.1 to 3.3.6), Expat (versions 2.3.0 to 2.7.5), PuTTY (versions 0.73 to 0.83), neon (versions 0.31.1 to 0.37.1), and Embarcadero C++Builder 11.
